verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a reschedule link that can be inserted into guest messages, and its workflows respond to reschedules and cancellations: remaining steps move to the new time or are called off. That shows invitee-driven rescheduling and cancellation are supported. However, nothing documents reschedule or cancellation policies such as notice windows, or that calendars are updated everywhere when an invitee makes a change. missing for 10: explicit reschedule/cancel links in the confirmation itself, reschedule/cancellation policy enforcement (cutoffs or notice limits), documented calendar sync on reschedule/cancel, independent or hands-on corroboration.
